author: independent evaluator
method: Exact endpoint/zero evaluation of rigid chord lines and mast endpoint centres over absolute tail travel -16 to +8 deg. Both rotation signs reported. Finite thickness, fittings, elastic deflection and body collision are excluded.
findings: Reported surface x [5.410,6.371] excludes zero-angle LE 5.400 and TE 6.400, although zero lies inside travel.

Reported surface z agrees with sign +1 to 0.001 m rounding; it does not establish clearance allowance. Sign -1 gives a different range, so sign +1 is inferred from the reported geometry, not explicitly specified.
Reported identical mast-top and mast-bottom x ranges cannot represent opposite endpoints under the same rotation. Their x displacements are opposite.
These are envelope errors, not proof of collision. The occupied solids and sign convention must be reconciled before a clearance verdict.
